themes.mechanism: :root[data-theme="light"] overrides the same custom properties; light-* frontmatter keys are the light values of the unprefixed roles

breaking-wash.purpose: Background of source lines cited by a breaking change.

help-wash.purpose: Background of source lines cited by a note.

verdict.purpose: The single ready-state verdict line, severity label in its ink.

status.purpose: Verdict line for pending, unavailable, skipped and failed Summary states.

headline.purpose: Technology name in the release header; version follows in muted mono.

summary-title.purpose: Summary title under the verdict, balanced wrap, 72ch.

title.purpose: Breaking-change heading beside its breaking[n]: code.

body.purpose: Key points, diagnostic explanations (68ch), help text.

source.purpose: Numbered release-notes view and fix diffs.

label.purpose: Cite pointers, breadcrumb path, header facts.

section-title.purpose: Lowercase mono section heading with count and trailing hairline rule.

motion.name: caret-draw
motion.purpose: The single motion moment: underline draws beneath each cited span when a cite pointer is followed. Reduced motion: no animation, underline shown immediately.

motion.name: digest-chevron
motion.purpose: Folded digest row open/close chevron; no transition under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: max-width, technology page only: release rows reflow to significance, version, right-aligned date, then full-width content; stat words may wrap.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: max-width, all pages: side padding 16px; carets hidden (in-quote 2px breaking underline instead), path and source meta hidden, gutters 4.5ch, note and diagnostic heads stack.
breakpoints.technologyPage: Stat words drop to a full-width second line; release rows keep the reflow; digest summary hides the version range and puts 'no action needed' on its own line; digest list loses its indent; verdict claim wraps below the label as a unit.
breakpoints.dashboard: Nav hidden; quota reads 'N followed'; stack rows reflow to technology, version, right-aligned date, then full-width content; section legend wraps to its own line; week summary hides the range and puts 'no action needed' on its own line; expanded week list one column, no indent; catalog picker facts drop under the name with the button spanning both lines.
breakpoints.technologies: Nav hidden; quota reads 'N followed'; status claim shortens to 'N of 10 followed'; filter label and right-aligned match count share line one, input full width below; picker rows two columns with facts under the name and the toggle or unfollowed note (right-aligned, 16ch max) spanning both lines; row error full width on a third line.

layout.releaseRow: grid 11ch significance / 14ch version / 11ch date / 1fr content, 16px column gap, 12px vertical padding, 1px rule below
layout.statList: 820px max; grid 3ch major / 1ch pipe / minmax(120px,1fr) bar / auto words, 16px gap, 8px vertical padding
layout.stackRow: grid 14ch technology / 17ch version with significance glyph / 11ch date / minmax(0,1fr) content, 16px column gap, 12px vertical padding (8px compact), 1px rule between rows and above the first
layout.weekRow: summary grid 14ch / 1fr / auto, 8px vertical padding; expanded lines indented calc(14ch + 16px), auto-fill minmax(28ch, 1fr)
layout.pickerRow: Technologies page: grid 16ch name / minmax(0,1fr) facts / auto toggle, 16px column gap, 12px vertical padding, align-items center, 1px rule between rows and above the first; row error spans columns 2 to end.

significanceGlyphs.featured: filled diamond, 12x12 viewBox: M6 1 11 6 6 11 1 6Z fill currentColor
significanceGlyphs.rule: Neutral only (text, text-muted, text-faint, rule-strong); never a severity ink. Always 12px SVG shapes, never a rotated CSS square. Paired with a Mono 13px muted label word, or with a section legend plus a screen-reader label in Dashboard rows.

extensions.verdictRule: The verdict keeps its token scale; copy must fit one line at the 1040px container. The claim is inline-block and wraps as a unit.

dashboard.pageVerdict: Verdict scale: 'warning: N need action' | 'ok: nothing needs action'; Mono 14px/1.7 muted count sentence, numbers in text, counts link to sections, no severity ink.
dashboard.spotlightOrder: One row per followed Technology: action rows, then ok rows, then compact 'latest major · none featured in 30 days' rows.
dashboard.thisWeekMark: Mono 12px text-muted 'this week' under the date for releases in the current ISO week (UTC).
dashboard.emptyState: Status-scale muted 'note:' line, muted intro, aria-live 'N of 10 followed' count, catalog picker rows with aria-pressed Follow/Following toggle, 'Open dashboard' button once N > 0.

technologies.followStatus: Status-scale text-muted line: info glyph + 'note:' + inline-block live claim 'you follow N of 10 technologies' (count in text); 'N of 10 followed' at sm. Muted Grotesk intro 12px below.
technologies.filter: role=search Mono 14px/1.7 muted sentence 24px below the intro: 'filter' label, 38px sunken search input 26ch (Mono 16px text, rule-strong border, text-faint on hover, 6px radius), live count 'N technologies' or 'N of M match' (first number in text).
technologies.sections: following (N), catalog (N), retired (N) only when present; while filtering 'following (N of M)'; sections with no match hidden; toggled rows stay put until the next visit.
technologies.limit: At 10 of 10: note line under the catalog title 'note: 10 of 10 followed · unfollow one to follow another'; unpressed toggles aria-disabled (focusable), border rule, text text-faint, cursor not-allowed, no hover change, aria-describedby the note.
technologies.rowError: Server-rejected follow: toggle reverts; x-circle + 'error: ...' Mono 13px/1.6 in breaking under the row, 8px above, spanning facts and toggle columns; toggle described by it; cleared on the next click in the row.
technologies.retired: Note line (Mono 14px muted note: + Grotesk 16px muted prose, no rules) then picker rows with facts 'last X · desc · retired YYYY-MM'; unfollow replaces the toggle with role=status Mono 13px muted 'unfollowed · can't be followed again'.
technologies.noMatch: Sections hidden; polite live section 48px below the filter: 'note: no technology matches "q"' (query in text) plus one muted Grotesk sentence; no form, no link, no ink.

narrative.overview:
A release reads like compiler output. One verdict line at display size, numbered `breaking[n]:` diagnostics that each point at their source lines with `-->`, quote the cited text over a caret row, and end in `= help:`. The release notes sit below as a numbered source view, clearly a separate part of the page from the Summary. Every claim can be checked against a highlighted line range.

The ground is terminal dark with one raised plane and one sunken well. Diagnostic severity is the only colour on the page. Fragment Mono carries the grammar: labels, versions, gutters, pointers, counts and metadata. Hanken Grotesk carries the prose that explains what changes. The page is dense and working-scale, not a marketing page. Width is set by a 72ch measure, and hierarchy comes from typography and gutters, not cards.

A light theme mirrors every role with darker severity inks on a warm off-white ground. Dark is the default.
keyCharacteristics: Severity colour is always paired with a label word and a glyph.
Monospace grammar (`note:`, `breaking[n]:`, `-->`, `|`, `=`, `help:`) is the component language.
Flat surfaces: three tonal layers (ground, raised, sunken) and 1px rules. No shadows.
One motion moment: the caret underline draws beneath cited spans.
The Summary and the source notes use different registers: grammar plus prose above, a numbered listing below.

rules.name: The Severity Pairing Rule
rules.body: A severity colour never appears alone. It always comes with its label word and its glyph: warning (triangle) + `warning:`, ok (check circle) + `ok:`, breaking (octagon) + `breaking[n]:`, error (x circle) + `error:`, note (info circle) + `note:`, help (wrench) + `help:`, pending (clock) + `pending:`.

rules.name: The Severity-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue means severity. There are no brand or decorative accents. `note:` and non-error status lines (`pending:`, unavailable, skipped) stay in `text-muted`. Only breaking, action, help and ok get an ink.

rules.name: The Neutral Significance Rule
rules.body: Release significance (featured, notable, digest, preview) is a shape, never a hue. Featured is a filled diamond, notable an outlined diamond, digest a small dot, preview a dashed outlined diamond. They are always 12px SVG shapes (never a rotated CSS square), drawn in `text`, `text-muted`, `text-faint` or `rule-strong`, and never in a severity ink. Severity can sit beside a significance glyph, but always as its own glyph and label.

rules.name: The One-Line Verdict Rule
rules.body: The verdict keeps its token scale on every surface. The copy is shortened to fit, and the scale never shrinks. At the 1040px container the whole verdict (glyph, label and claim) must fit on one line, so a range verdict reads `warning: 1 needs action`, not `warning: 1 release needs action`. The claim after the label is set inline-block, so when narrow screens force a wrap, it drops to the next line as a unit and never splits mid-phrase.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Anything a compiler would print (labels, codes, pointers, versions, counts, line numbers, dates) is set in Fragment Mono. Sentences a person reads are set in Hanken Grotesk. Don't mix them within one role.

rules.name: The One Raised Plane Rule
rules.body: Only the release-notes source view sits on `raised`. Quoted and code material sinks. Nothing floats.

dos: Do pair every severity ink with its glyph and label word (see The Severity Pairing Rule).
Do cite every key point and breaking change with a `release-notes:N` or `N-M` pointer that highlights exactly those lines in the source view.
Do set grammar, numbers and line references in Fragment Mono with tabular numerals, and explanations in Hanken Grotesk.
Do replace caret rows with an in-quote 2px `breaking` underline at 640px and below.
Do keep the caret-draw as the single motion moment, with an immediate fallback under reduced motion.
Do define both themes for every colour role. Dark is the default.
Do mark release significance with the neutral SVG shape glyphs (see The Neutral Significance Rule).
Do give navigational links their grammar: a faint `-->` arrow and a cyan dashed-underline label.
Do keep neutral row verdicts (`note:`, `pending:`) and dashboard counts in `text-muted`, with no ink.
Do write counts in words beside every bar, using the list's own vocabulary, with a legend that repeats the shape glyphs.
Do shorten verdict copy until it fits on one line at the 1040px container, and set the claim inline-block so it wraps as a unit (see The One-Line Verdict Rule).
Do disable a Follow toggle at the limit with `aria-disabled`, keep it focusable, and describe it by the `note:` line that explains the limit.
donts: Don't use hue for anything but severity. There are no brand accents or decorative colour.
Don't add shadows or extra raised surfaces. Depth is `sunken` / `ground` / one `raised`.
Don't wrap diagnostics in cards or badges. Structure comes from gutters and grammar.
Don't colour `note:` or non-error status lines. They stay `text-muted`.
Don't give significance (featured, notable, digest, preview) a severity ink, and don't let a bar carry meaning without its counts in words.
Don't shrink the verdict scale to fit longer copy.
